Authorship.description: How the numbers of a served hand-written release were written.

oneOf.description: Typed before any outcome of the data it is scored on was opened (W0, reference laws).
Typed after its author read development (train) data or development feedback.

ModelInput.description: One input a served release reads.

example.description: Example value for a typed scenario (never a measurement).

name.description: Condition key, control name, or quantity of the observations.

note.description: What it is, in one line.

required.description: The forward refuses a prefix without it.

text.description: A text value (e.g. a fuel name), not a number.

unit_si.description: SI unit of the value (`1` for dimensionless and text values).

ModelInputKind.description: Where a forecast input comes from.

oneOf.description: A known condition of the test (`PrefixBundle.known_conditions`).
Observations of the run before the cutoff (`PrefixBundle.observations`).
The test date (selects laws that depend on the era of the test).

When the modelled phase was established, seconds since the time origin
(`ScenarioRequest.phase_established_at_s`).

Executes, not qualified by any evaluation. Every literal (WSP) release is created in this
state; qualification is recorded by an `EvaluationResult`, never by rewriting the release.

ReportedScore.description:
A score as the authoring lane reported it, with where it was reported. Development numbers
only: no score on a test partition is carried here.

comparison.description: Comparison as reported (baselines, intervals), if any.

metric.description: Metric and the data it is measured on.

source.description: Document (repository path) and section the number is quoted from.

value.description: The value as reported, with its unit, e.g. "40.0 µm".

TrainedOn.description:
What data conventionally trained the release's parameters. There is deliberately no default:
schema 2.0.0 defaulted to `nasa`, which labels any release that omits the field (a handwritten
one, say) as NASA-trained. Writers must state it. Legacy files without the field are read by
[`crate::registry::parse_release`] with their old meaning, and only when they carry no
`construction` record.

oneOf.description:
No conventional training: the values were written literally (WSP). Requires a literal
`ModelRelease.construction` manifest.

WspSchema.description: Wire tag of model specs, patches, build manifests and forecast requests.

description:
What the server states about a served hand-written release besides its immutable record. Read
from the deployment's served list (`configs/models/served.json`), never from a request.

authorship_note.description: One line on how it was written (zero-shot parts, revisions).

candidate.description: The candidate name the authoring lane uses (D3, F2, ...).

forecasts.description: What it forecasts, in one sentence.

inputs_note.description: What a stored run or a typed scenario must give, and why one may not be enough.

investigation.description: NASA investigation(s) the release is written for, e.g. "FLEX (PSI-69)".

state.description: Copied from the release record: `experimental` for a literal release.

stored_runs.description: Whether this deployment builds its prefix from a stored NASA run.

trained_on.description: Copied from the release record: `not_trained` for a literal release.
